clue.text: Volume of dispensable products

parts.note: a volume is a book, and the products are ones a chemist dispenses: a reference book listing medicines

explanation.surface: A catalogue of throwaway goods nobody really needs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dispensable' reads as 'not needed', but here it means able to be dispensed by a pharmacist.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the official book listing drugs and how to prepare them, so a volume of things a pharmacist dispenses.

clue.text: Retreat if tanning is being done in the open air

parts.note: a hide is the animal skin that gets tanned into leather
out means outdoors

explanation.surface: Sunbathers outdoors might run for cover.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tanning' suggests sunbathing, but it points to the skin that a tanner treats.
explanation.definitionFit: A hideaway is a place one withdraws to, a retreat or refuge.

clue.text: Bore out a pile of paper

definitions.meaning: to widen a drilled hole with a tool
a quantity of 480 or 500 sheets

explanation.definitionFit: One word is both the verb for enlarging a hole with a reamer and the stationer's unit of about five hundred sheets.

clue.text: Rest of the firewood and metal

parts.note: iron is a metal

explanation.surface: Leftover logs and scrap metal by the hearth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rest' looks like 'remainder', but it is a support: the logs rest on it.
explanation.definitionFit: A firedog is a metal stand in a fireplace that holds logs up, a rest for the fuel.

clue.text: Propose about one cent for a recipient of commission

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece is placed around the others

parts.note: to propose is to offer
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Suggesting a tiny fee for someone who earns a commission on sales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I and C inside OFFER. 'Commission' suggests sales pay, but it is the document granting military rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A military officer holds a commission, the warrant conferring rank.

clue.text: Claim we make calls for lots of time

indicators.note: said aloud, with the h dropped, the word for a long stretch of time sounds like the possessive

parts.note: hours are a long period of time

explanation.surface: A firm demands that its staff phone at length.
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone relies on a dropped H.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'it's ours' is the possessive claim a group makes over something.

clue.text: Cut off a confession of extreme unpunctuality

definitions.meaning: to separate or keep apart from others
split into a first-person pronoun, an intensifier and a word for tardy, the letters admit to being very behind time

explanation.definitionFit: To isolate is to set apart, cutting someone off; split up, the letters also say someone admits being very tardy.

clue.text: Lofty messengers

parts.note: lofty seems to mean high-minded, but these messengers live in lofts and fly back to them with notes

explanation.definitionFit: Racing birds kept in lofts return there carrying messages, so they are carriers who live in lofts.

clue.text: The highest scoring sportsmen who only reproduce the score?

definitions.meaning: players who set a scoring record
machines that play back a piece of music from discs

explanation.definitionFit: Gramophones play back recorded music, the score; read another way, the phrase means athletes holding scoring records.

clue.text: One who knows a trick or two used cards

definitions.text: One who knows a trick or two

parts.note: used means old, second-hand
a hand is the set of cards a player holds

explanation.surface: A card sharp whose deck has seen better days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A trick or two' sounds like card play, matching 'cards', but it means experience.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran is experienced and knows the tricks of a trade.

clue.text: Showed patience in the interests of a tedious fellow

parts.note: for means on behalf of
a bore is a dull person

explanation.surface: Someone stayed calm for the sake of a dull companion.
explanation.definitionFit: To have refrained or held back with restraint is to have shown patience.

clue.text: Not a figure of speech from the sort of Esperanto followed by 50

parts.note: Ido is an invented language derived from Esperanto
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A grammarian disowns a phrase lifted from an invented language.
explanation.walkthrough: IDO is an artificial language that grew out of Esperanto. The definition plays on 'figure of speech': this figure is a statue, not a turn of phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipped image is a figure in the sense of a carved statue, not a rhetorical one.

clue.text: Solve the latest drug problem

definitions.meaning: to work out a code or puzzle
a smokable form of cocaine, a newer narcotic menace when this was set

explanation.definitionFit: One word means to work out a code and also names a cocaine derivative that spread as a social scourge.

clue.text: Appeal to Henry over the head of a saintly figure

definitions.text: over the head of a saintly figure

parts.note: Hal is a pet form of Henry
O is a cry of entreaty, as in 'O Lord'

explanation.surface: A plea addressed to Henry, above some holy person's authority.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over the head of' reads as going above someone's authority, but it is literal: the ring floats above a saint's head.
explanation.definitionFit: A nimbus of light is drawn hovering above a saint's head in religious art.

clue.text: Decayed molar teaches one a lesson

definitions.note: a verb phrase for the noun: the point of a story, which teaches a lesson

indicators.note: decayed suggests the tooth has broken down, so its letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A rotten tooth is a warning to look after your teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: The point a fable makes is the lesson it teaches the reader.

clue.text: Melancholy resulting from a perpetual household problem

parts.note: dust keeps building up however often one cleans

explanation.surface: Someone is depressed by endless housework.
explanation.walkthrough: ADUST is an old word, literally scorched, once used of a gloomy temperament.
explanation.definitionFit: In old medical theory a scorched, dark humour caused gloom, so the word came to mean sombre or gloomy.

clue.text: Obtain fluffy feathers from duck

parts.note: to obtain is to get
down is the soft fine plumage of birds

explanation.surface: Collecting soft plumage from a waterfowl, as for an eiderdown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duck' looks like the bird, matching the feathers, but it is the verb: crouch low.
explanation.definitionFit: To duck is to drop low quickly to avoid something, as one does when told to crouch.

clue.text: Carrots for Mr Gorbachev

definitions.meaning: a nickname for someone with ginger hair
the communist (red) leader (head) of the Soviet Union

explanation.definitionFit: A ginger-haired person is nicknamed Carrots; Gorbachev was head of the Soviet 'Reds', with a famous mark on his scalp.

clue.text: Try in parliament to get one parliamentarian everyone follows

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament
each means every one

explanation.surface: A plan to prosecute a politician in the Commons, with everyone behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: To charge a public official with misconduct before a legislature is to put them on trial there.

clue.text: Train up in a way that makes for a prudish character

indicators.note: set out in a different way, the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Bringing a child up so strictly they become a prude.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait-laced person with strict moral views is called this, after the austere Protestant sect.

clue.text: Holds up picnic baskets

definitions.meaning: to obstruct or delay
wicker containers for food

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means obstructs or delays, and the plural noun names lidded wicker food baskets.

clue.text: Hot drink now converted to steam?

definitions.meaning: spiced ale drunk at Christmas
split as a past-tense verb and a word for canvas power: a ship that once used canvas but now runs on engines

explanation.definitionFit: It is mulled spiced ale for festive toasts; split, it says a vessel formerly sailed before switching to engines.

clue.text: West gets club of suit for one of the pack

indicators.note: to suit is to adapt or alter, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: In a card game, West plays a club and must follow suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' rearranges CLUB OF into OLFCUB. Club and suit look like cards; the pack is a Cub Scout pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Junior members of the Scout movement were organised in packs, so one is a junior member of a pack.

clue.text: Famous school invested in unbeatable service and is solvent

indicators.note: to be invested in is to be placed inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: an ace is a serve in tennis the opponent cannot return
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: A top school puts money into a winning tennis venture and stays in the black.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solvent' reads as financially sound, but it is a liquid that dissolves things. ETON is Britain's best-known boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common liquid used to dissolve paint and nail varnish.

clue.text: Deserve to make money

definitions.meaning: to merit something
to be paid for work

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to merit a reward and to be paid wages.

clue.text: Fish had apparently been left too long!

definitions.meaning: a small silvery food fish

definitions.text: had apparently been left too long!
definitions.meaning: the past tense of a verb of odour: food left out gave off a pong

explanation.definitionFit: It names a small silvery fish and is also a British past tense of 'smell', as stale food did.

clue.text: Insubstantial nest

definitions.meaning: light and ethereal, an old spelling of airy
a variant spelling of eyrie, an eagle's nest

explanation.definitionFit: It is an old spelling of airy, meaning ethereal, and a variant of eyrie, a bird of prey's nest.

clue.text: Crippled but plucky

definitions.meaning: lame, of a leg
brave and willing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means lame, as a gammy leg, and also brave and willing to have a go.

clue.text: Nero contrived to be a remarkable person

indicators.note: contrived means put together artfully, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: The emperor schemed to be thought exceptional.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang this is a unique or remarkable person or thing.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for someone or something one of a kind, quite exceptional.

clue.text: Not an ethnic problem which has completely disappeared

definitions.note: a clause describing something that has vanished leaving none

parts.note: race as an issue of ethnicity

explanation.surface: Insisting a vanished issue was never about ethnicity.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from 'vanished without trace'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with nothing left to show it existed has vanished utterly.

clue.text: To study the journey get a line on the map

parts.note: to con is an old verb meaning to study or learn
a tour is a journey

explanation.surface: Planning a trip by poring over the route on a map.
explanation.definitionFit: Maps show height by lines joining points of equal elevation.

clue.text: Smoker in church

parts.note: a smoker sounds like someone with a cigarette, but here it is a vessel that gives off fragrant smoke during worship

explanation.definitionFit: A censer is a vessel in which fragrant resin smoulders during services, so it puts out smoke.
